verdict.rationale: mise has documented CI integration (mise-action wrapping install, version pinning recommendations, lockfile/bump commands, MISE_SAFE mode) which speaks to fast, reproducible CI installs, but there is no explicit documentation of a cache-restore step (e.g. actions/cache integration for the mise tool install directory) or an offline-install mode. missing for 10: documented cache key/restore pattern for CI (e.g. caching ~/.local/share/mise), explicit offline-mode or air-gapped install support docs, independent verification that mise-action speeds up CI via caching.
